events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, was born on July 26, 1943, in Dartford, Kent, England.

angles.name: Rock and Roll Never Dies
angles.copy: The Rolling Stones' frontman, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, continuing to prove that rock and roll truly never dies.

events.title: MTV launched with 'Video Killed The Radio Star'
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Big Bang
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto screens, changing the music landscape forever with its very first video: The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

events.title: Oasis released 'Definitely Maybe'
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop Debut
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago this month, Oasis dropped their debut album 'Definitely Maybe', cementing their place as Britpop legends and a defining sound of the 90s.

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a three-day festival of 'Peace & Music', took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the legendary Woodstock festival kicked off, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace, love, and iconic music.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death (would have been 91)
events.blurb: Elvis Presley died on August 16, 1977, and would have been 91 years old this year, having been born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's death (would have been 55)
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, in Las Vegas, Nevada, at the age of 25. He was born on June 16, 1971.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this month, the world lost a hip-hop icon, Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death (would have been 84)
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27. He was born on November 27, 1942.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago this month, the music world mourned the loss of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago this month, The Beatles delivered their iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: The Pretenders' Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the unmistakable voice of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock and Roll Swagger
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, still bringing the rock and roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine' single
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem of Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago this month, John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine', a message of peace that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple unveiled the first iPod, revolutionising how we carry and listen to our music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' first hit screens and introduced the world to 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: A very happy 87th birthday to the comedy icon, John Cleese, a true titan of British humour.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago this month, The Beatles released their sprawling, self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album'.
